answer: New agents lock a crystal stake of 500 POA in a transparent capsule for 30 days. To activate, each must crack a walnut: sequential proof-of-work needing 24h single-thread compute, impossible to parallelize. Agents enter the ocean, a pool of 10,000 where daily VRF currents shuffle all into pods of 10, each pod vouching for newcomers. Forging 1,000 Sybils burns 500,000 POA for a month plus 1,000 compute-days, yet the ocean scatters fakes so none vouch for each other, each needing 9 genuine vouches it never gets. Like fake pearls in the sea, currents separate them and no oyster claims them.
